name: anomality-demo
note: anomality app demo: a subtle bed (kalimba roots, a marimba note per beat, no drums) under real UI sounds: a click on every recorded click, a key per letter typed, a barely-there glide on each camera move, a light tap as each caption lands, one bell on the end mark.

click.note: a small plastic click, a CC0 recording fitted as code: clicks lead the cut by ~11 ms

key.note: realistic mid keys (1.3-4.4 kHz), a new take per keystroke, ~87 ms apart in a run

key.return.note: the run's own switch on its own seeds, a little louder

land.light.note: a light finger tap (150-260 Hz and a faint click), low under the bed: taps lead the cut by ~60 ms

pop.note: the soft rounded mid pop (0.14 s, 550 Hz, 22 ms onset, t20 75 ms): the most used effect, in runs ~114 ms apart

whoosh.long.note: a big low whoosh that lands with a thump ~80 ms in and rings ~0.35 s

bell.note: a gated glockenspiel note doubled an octave under (0.35 s), C pentatonic G4-E6, set wide (L / R correlation 0.6): notes lead the cut by ~20 ms

m.arp.note: music: one soft marimba note per beat

m.root.note: music: kalimba root on every bar line, ringing
